interpretation: Three current xhigh routes are compared within this batch only.
All actual attempts contribute usage and retry-summed clocks, including voided groups.
Unknown reasoning usage is null, with explicit field coverage; never coerced to zero.
Usage events count successful usage-bearing responses, not every attempted model call.
Void/infra/harness/interrupted are excluded from the main score denominator.
Existing stream-failure classification gaps are recorded, not repaired or retried.
Parent supplies resource evidence, archives, documentation and final service state.
